theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_la_graphPoint_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ) (i : Fin n), graphPoint a b (Fin.castAdd ℓ i) = a i) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ) (j : Fin ℓ), graphPoint a b (Fin.natAdd n j) = b j) ∧ (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), graphPoint (a + a') (b + b') = graphPoint a b + graphPoint a' b') ∧ (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), graphPoint (a - a') (b - b') = graphPoint a b - graphPoint a' b') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), graphPoint (t • a) (t • b) = t • graphPoint a b) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), ‖graphPoint a b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), inner ℝ (graphPoint a b) (graphPoint a' b') = inner ℝ a a' + inner ℝ b b')
